items.title: Approve the Minutes of the October 20, 2020 Meeting
[Final Approval] Appoint Robert Gower and David Klein to the Citizens Advisory Committee
[Final Approval] Adopt Traffic Congestion Mitigation Tax (TNC Tax) Program Guidelines and Program $7,505,686 in TNC Tax Funds to Two Projects

[Final Approval] Allocate $5,897,303 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds, $378,372 in Prop AA Vehicle Registration Fee Funds, and $2,505,686 in Traffic Congestion Mitigation Tax (TNC Tax) Funds, with Conditions, for Five Requests

[Final Approval] Authorize the Executive Director to Execute the Utility Relocation Agreement, the Right of Way Certification, Amendments to the Memorandums of Agreement (MOAs) with Treasure Island Development Authority
[Final Approval on First Appearance] Oppose the Plan Bay Area (PBA) 2050 Final Blueprint Telecommute Mandate Strategy
Major Capital Project Update - Better Market Street
Walk San Francisco’s Congestion Pricing Outreach Other Items
